map.依据 AATCC 100 定量抗菌测试法计算抑菌率与抗菌活性值（对数减少），判读: Computes the bacterial reduction rate and antibacterial activity value (log reduction) under the AATCC 100 quantitative antibacterial test method, for reading textile antibacterial performance. Enter the viable counts for the "0 hour control" and the "24 hour sample".
map.📖 查看「AATCC 100 抗菌测试 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "AATCC 100 Antibacterial Test Usage Guide"
map.A：0h 对照活菌数（CFU/mL）: A: viable count of the 0h control (CFU/mL)
map.B：接触后试样活菌数（CFU/mL）: B: viable count on the sample after contact (CFU/mL)
map.C：接触后对照活菌数（CFU/mL，选填）: C: viable count of the control after contact (CFU/mL, optional)
map.抑菌率 = (A − B) / A × 100%；抗菌活性值 R = log₁₀: Bacterial reduction rate = (A − B) / A × 100%; antibacterial activity value R = log₁₀(A) − log₁₀(B)
map.AATCC 100 要求 0h 接种量约 1×10⁵~3×10⁵ CFU/mL；: AATCC 100 requires a 0h inoculum of about 1×10⁵~3×10⁵ CFU/mL; a reduction rate ≥99% (R≥2) is normally regarded as antibacterial pass
map.若 B>A 说明试样无抗菌作用或菌已生长，抑菌率为负: If B>A the sample has no antibacterial action or the bacteria have grown, so the reduction rate is negative
map.抗菌纺织品功效评价：对比处理样与空白样的活菌减少，量化抑菌效果。: Efficacy evaluation of antibacterial textiles: compare the viable count reduction between treated and blank samples to quantify antibacterial effect.
map.抗菌剂筛选与工艺优化：不同整理剂或浓度下的抑菌率比较择优。: Antibacterial agent screening and process optimisation: compare reduction rates across different finishes or concentrations to pick the best.
map.质检报告数据核算：由实测菌落数快速算抑菌率/对数值，辅助报告出具与宣称合规判定。: Quality report data checking: quickly compute the reduction rate / log value from measured colony counts, assisting report preparation and claim compliance judgement.
map.银离子整理织物抗菌核算示例: Example antibacterial calculation for silver-ion finished fabric
map.空白样 0h 与 18h 活菌数分别为 2.0×10⁵、1.8×10⁵ CFU/: The blank sample has viable counts of 2.0×10⁵ at 0h and 1.8×10⁵ CFU/mL at 18h, and the treated sample is 3.0×10² CFU/mL at 18h; reduction rate=(1-3.0×10²/1.8×10⁵)×100%≈99.8%, log reduction=log10(1.8×10⁵/3.0×10²)≈2.8.
map.抑菌率和对数减少值有什么不同？: What is the difference between reduction rate and log reduction?
map.抑菌率是活菌减少的百分数，直观；对数减少值(log reduction)表示数量: The reduction rate is the percentage drop in viable count, which is intuitive; the log reduction expresses the drop in orders of magnitude and is more sensitive for highly antibacterial samples, so evaluating both is more complete.
map.接种菌量和接触时间怎么设？: How are the inoculum and contact time set?
map.按 AATCC 100 规定菌种（如金黄色葡萄球菌、大肠杆菌）与接种浓度、接触时: Follow AATCC 100 for the organism (such as Staphylococcus aureus or Escherichia coli), the inoculum concentration and the contact time; deviating from the standard affects comparability of results.
map.结果能直接用于产品宣称吗？: Can the result be used directly for product claims?
map.测算基于你填入的菌落数据，仅供评价参考；产品抗菌宣称须按标准方法由具备资质实验室: The calculation is based on the colony counts you entered and is for evaluation reference only; antibacterial product claims must be reported by a qualified laboratory using the standard method and comply with the relevant regulations.
map.AATCC 100 是美国纺织化学师协会的抗菌定量测试标准，通过比较接种 0 小: AATCC 100 is the American Association of Textile Chemists and Colorists quantitative antibacterial test standard. It compares the viable counts at 0 hours after inoculation and on the sample after contact, computes the reduction rate and log reduction, and evaluates textile antibacterial performance.
map.抑菌率与对数减少值双指标: Dual metrics of reduction rate and log reduction
map.多菌种、可设接触时间: Multiple organisms with configurable contact time
map.抗菌剂筛选与工艺优化: Antibacterial agent screening and process optimisation
map.抗菌产品宣称合规判定: Compliance judgement for antibacterial product claims
